steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 1 is worth 50% of the GCSE and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: It covers both Greek and Roman mythology and religion — comparison between cultures is essential

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The paper tests knowledge of myths, religious practices, temples, festivals and beliefs about death

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Visual source analysis is central — you must discuss vase paintings, sculpture and architecture

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What percentage is Paper 1 worth? | Q: Why is comparison essential for Paper 1? | Q: How should you approach a visual source question?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: 50% — equally weighted with Paper 2. | The paper covers both cultures and thematic questions require comparing their approaches to the same topic. | Describe what you see, identify the subject matter, analyse its significance, then evaluate limitations.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always compare Greek AND Roman examples For visual sources: describe, identify, analyse, evaluate Use technical vocabulary: xenia, pax deorum, prothesis, metamorphosis The 'how far' extended question needs balanced argument with judgement Know specific named examples: Parthenon, Pantheon, Panathenaea, Eleusinian Mysteries
